scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Miscarriage for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Delhi.
Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
Must be a registered women member under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, or the wife of a registered male member.
Must have suffered a miscarriage during delivery.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹3,000 to a female member or the wife of a male member in case of miscarriage.
